system.roleplaying: It is vitally important that you hide your true identity. You have a career that allows you to slip between identities when necessary.
system.minorTwist: What clue about your real identity did you leave behind?
system.majorTwist: Who from your civilian life is now in imminent danger?

greenAbility.name: Principle of the Mask
greenAbility.gameText: Overcome using knowledge from your civilian life and use your Max die. You and each of your allies gain a hero point.
